head: codex/5717-podcast-studio-copy
title: [v0.91.8][podcast][ui] Prepare Synthetic Minds podcast launch routes
body:
Closes #5717

Prepares the Synthetic Minds Podcast launch surface for review: serves the studio at `/podcast/`, adds an unlinked `/_preview/podcast/` route with `noindex,nofollow`, updates RSS/feed metadata, keeps the WAV as an explicitly labeled smoke sample, and aligns the linked sample page with that truth.

Also preserves the operator copy fixes: correct Agent Logic SVG logo, blue Minds treatment, Friday planned cadence, contact button to `podcast@agent-logic.ai`, no footer email, no video claim, human and model guest support, and ten proposed launch topics without fake playable episode rows.

Validation: typed C-SDLC doctor PASS; structural podcast launch validation PASS; local deploy-shape HTTP smoke PASS for `/podcast/`, `/_preview/podcast/`, `/podcast/feed.xml`, and `/podcast/audio/meet-the-ai-coworkers.wav`; `git diff --check` PASS. Exact-head codex subagent review of `b2c7271a8` returned CLEAN; current head contains metadata-only review/publication lifecycle updates. Residual launch prerequisites remain public HTTPS deploy, mailbox verification, final show artwork, final approved audio/title/description/date/content-rights truth, directory submissions, and human approval.
